جننتما (form I)
# جَنَنْتُمَا (janantumā) /d͡ʒa.nan.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of جَنَّ (janna)
# جُنِنْتُمَا (junintumā) /d͡ʒu.nin.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
